about.story.title: From Our Hands to Yours
about.story.p1: Cleopatra was born from a passion for pure, honest beauty. Inspired by the legendary queen's devotion to natural beauty rituals, we create premium handmade cosmetics in small batches at our atelier in Germany.
about.story.p2: Every product begins with carefully sourced natural ingredients — rich butters, nourishing oils, and botanical extracts. Our artisans hand-pour each bar, infusing decades of cold-process soap-making expertise with time-honored formulations.
about.story.p3: We believe that what you put on your skin matters. That's why our products are free from synthetic additives, sulfates, and palm oil. Just nature's finest, transformed with care into timeless beauty essentials.

product.royalMilk.name: Royal Milk Soap
product.royalMilk.subtitle: Royal Milk
product.royalMilk.description: A luxurious, hydrating soap infused with nourishing goat's milk and pure honey. This cold-processed bar delivers deep moisture while gently cleansing, leaving your skin silky smooth and radiant.
product.royalMilk.scent: Delicate floral notes with a warm, creamy base. Notes of white jasmine and honey with a soft vanilla undertone create a luxurious bathing experience.
product.royalMilk.usage: Lather between wet hands or with a washcloth. Apply to damp skin in gentle circular motions. Rinse thoroughly. For best results, pair with a Cleopatra soap dish to extend the life of your bar.
product.royalMilk.inci: Sodium Olivate, Sodium Cocoate, Sodium Palmate (RSPO), Goat's Milk, Mel (Honey), Kaolin, Sodium Chloride, Citric Acid, Sodium Lactate, Parfum (Natural), CI 77891
product.blackPearl.name: Black Pearl Charcoal Soap
product.blackPearl.subtitle: Black Pearl
product.blackPearl.description: A detoxifying charcoal soap that draws out impurities while nourishing your skin with activated bamboo charcoal and essential oils. Perfect for a deep cleanse that leaves skin refreshed and renewed.
product.blackPearl.scent: Fresh and invigorating with notes of eucalyptus, tea tree, and a subtle hint of cedarwood. A grounding, spa-like fragrance that awakens the senses.
product.blackPearl.usage: Work into a rich lather with water and massage onto face or body. Focus on areas prone to oiliness or congestion. Rinse thoroughly. Use daily or as needed for a purifying cleanse.
product.blackPearl.inci: Sodium Olivate, Sodium Cocoate, Sodium Palmate (RSPO), Charcoal (Activated Bamboo), Bentonite Clay, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Oil, Eucalyptus Globulus Oil, Cedrus Atlantica (Cedarwood) Oil, Sodium Chloride, Citric Acid, Sodium Lactate
product.honeySilk.name: Honey & Oats Soap
product.honeySilk.subtitle: Honey Silk
product.honeySilk.description: A soothing, comforting soap enriched with raw honey and colloidal oatmeal. This gentle bar calms irritated skin while providing deep hydration and a protective moisture barrier.
product.honeySilk.scent: Warm and comforting with sweet honey notes blended with vanilla and a touch of almond. Like a warm embrace, this scent soothes both skin and soul.
product.honeySilk.usage: Create a creamy lather and apply to skin. The oat particles provide gentle exfoliation — massage lightly for best results. Rinse with warm water. Ideal for evening self-care rituals.
product.honeySilk.inci: Sodium Olivate, Sodium Cocoate, Sodium Palmate (RSPO), Mel (Honey), Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Flour, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea Butter), Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Oil, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Sodium Chloride, Citric Acid, Sodium Lactate, CI 77891
